newsitem.title: UK: Welshman sees return of Thatcher in Nostradamus.
newsitem.headline: Welshman sees return of Thatcher in Nostradamus.

text.p: A Welshman captivated by Nostradamus' prediction that "she who has been cast out will return again" has put money on the political reincarnation of former British Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher.

"This Welshman stands to win 25,000 pounds ($41,520) if Thatcher returns to the helm of the Conservative Party by 1999," Simon Clare, political betting spokesman at Ladbrokes bookmakers, told Reuters.
Clare said the Welshman placed a 100 pound ($166) bet on Tuesday at odds of 250-1, basing his gamble on the prophecies of the French 16th-century astrologer.

"Nosatradamus says that in 1999 she who has been cast out will return again and he has taken a view that this applies to Thatcher," said Clare. "He believes the Tories (Conservatives) will collapse in squabbling and look for a strong character to lead them in the fight against Europe and the Labour Party. The answer: a return to the tried and trusted Maggie."

"Iron Lady" Thatcher, whose downfall in 1990 after 11 years in office and 15 years at the head of the Conservative Party was engineered by malcontents in her own party, says she has no plans to return to politics.
